title: Mä ratuk sarir Trono
intro: Mä jachʼa autoridadajj mä qamir reinoruw apnaqäna, uka reinojj jan jaktʼkay qamir reinoruw apnaqäna. Kunapachatï mä jan suytʼat jan waltʼäwix utjkäna ukhaxa, uka apnaqirix janiw espadampi yantʼatäkänti, jan ukasti yatiñampi ukat iyawsäwimpiw yantʼäna. Kunatï uñstkäna ukajja, akapachan chʼamapan wali jachʼa chʼamapatjja, chuyma mayjtʼayañaruw puriyañapäna.
clues: Nayajj mä reino apnaqayäta, uka reinojj qamirïñampi ukat suma qamañampi bendicitänwa, janiw amuytʼañjamäkänti
Nayajj wali chʼamani reyïtwa, jan ajjsartʼasaw mä carta katoqayäta, ukanjja jupar katuyasiñaw mayitäna
Jachʼa jilïrinakajajj uka jaya reyimpi nuwasiñati jan ukajj sumankañacha sasaw ewjjtʼapjjetäna
Naya pachpaw uka jaya reyimp jikisiñatakix wali suma regalonak aptʼasiwayta
Reyin tronojajj mä chʼipjjtatwa jaya oraqer apanipjjäna, janïr kuttʼkasa
Kunapachatï mä palacio mantayäta, uka palaciojj vidriot uñtat suma pisompiw utjäna, qhepatjja Allahar katuyasitajatwa yatiyta

trial.label: Yant’awi/Evento
options: Mä jach’a qillqat katuqaña, ukax apayanipxañapatakiw mayi
Uma jalsumpi mä markar tʼunjatätap uñjasa
trial.answer: Mä jach’a qillqat katuqaña, ukax apayanipxañapatakiw mayi

location.label: Elemento Clave ukax mä juk’a pachanakanwa
options: Qurimpi ukat qalanakampi lurat mä jachʼa reyin trono
Mä qollu patjjan samartʼir mä arca
Makkah markan mä qullan yupaychañ uta
Mä markan yupaychata quri vaca qallu
location.answer: Qurimpi ukat qalanakampi lurat mä jachʼa reyin trono

outcome.label: Utjiri
options: Mä profetamp chika Allah ukar katuyasiña
Mä uñisirir arknaqkasax qutan umamp chhaqhayasiña
Mä milagro tuqi nina nakhantat qhispiyasiña
outcome.answer: Mä profetamp chika Allah ukar katuyasiña

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verse: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh]. (27:42)
